purpose: Ten pure-symbol variations combining24 curved lobes / negative-space command aperture with35 continuous folding. No lettering in any delivered concept. Opaque artboards; no original or application assets replaced.

concepts.name: 短宽开壳
concepts.change: 双瓣变得短宽，扩大命令开口，轮廓更紧凑。
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / precise-object-edit.
Create ONE new PURE SYMBOL refinement combining the selected DockShell concepts. The user explicitly requests NO WORDMARK and NO TEXT ANYWHERE.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image1 (concept24): rounded upper/lower shell lobes, rich violet identity, full negative-space right-facing > command-chevron.
Image2 (concept35): one-piece material folding continuously back around the RIGHT hinge, large clear folded surfaces.
Image3 (concept51): an example of combining those two ideas; use as continuity guidance, not as a constraint to repeat the exact same proportions. REMOVE its text.

MANDATORY CORE:
Two shell lobes connected as ONE continuous fold at the right; a clear FULL > negative-space opening between them, with two diagonal white/background arms and their short vertical left step cuts. Do not reduce the gap to a plain triangular wedge. The chevron is empty space showing the background, not a printed arrow on the surface.
Retain shell/terminal meaning while making the specified geometric variation below visibly distinct. One compact memorable silhouette, large and optically centered with generous square-artboard margins. No tiny folds, no excessive surface details.
No letters, wordmark, brand name, caption, digits, watermark, slogan, duplicated emblem, contact sheet or extra objects. No container app tile, shield, lock, monitor, paper airplane, boat, butterfly, play triangle, ocean shell ridges or commercial logo imitation. Opaque artboard background. Do NOT reserve a blank area below for a wordmark; center the symbol itself in both axes.

GEOMETRY: a short broad compact two-lobe shell, its footprint a softly flattened near-circle, width about1.15 times height. Shorten both left ends, broaden the right hairpin bend, make the negative-space command chevron noticeably broad and clear. Upper and lower lobes near equal mass, with upper left end slightly shorter. Thick large simple areas, curved outer corners.
MATERIAL: matte royal-violet outer surfaces, lilac inner fold faces, very shallow restrained depth. Pale lavender-white background. No cast shadow or texture. Large icon symbol only.

concepts.name: 流线回折
